notes: Civil War pilot profile (plan G3). Ford walkability is the founding evidence of SHALLOW_BUILD_DEPTH_M=1.5 (scripts/mapsim/waterdata.py).

evidence.claim: The river ford shallows are walkable and buildable at their 1.5 m carve depth; the main channel blocks land units.
evidence.ref: user verification during mapsim shallow calibration, session 2026-08-09

evidence.claim: Map generates and plays; the trade-route harbours dock onto the route in-game.
evidence.ref: regular playtesting of the map by the author

evidence.claim: Native islands appear on the in-game minimap at reduced size - the authored tile budget oversizes them and the engine keeps the partial fill (rmSetAreaWarnFailure idiom).

expectations.why: east ford strip must stay walkable-buildable water
main river channel must block land units

tests.why: both players must start on dry land, on opposite river banks

known_issues.why: harbours dock onto the route in-game; the model's nominal route resolution overestimates the offset (re-triage at G6)
native islands render small-but-present in-game; the authored budget intentionally oversizes them and the engine keeps the partial fill
